entries.name: Personal Mandate Drift
entries.boundary: The person's current authorization and its duration.
entries.focus: Continuing consent, expiry, and withdrawal of a personal mandate.

entries.name: Personal Account and Recovery Takeover
entries.boundary: Control of accounts, credentials, sessions, and recovery channels.
entries.focus: Concentrated account access and independent recovery.

entries.name: Private Life Context Exposure
entries.boundary: Permitted flow of personal information across audiences and purposes.
entries.focus: Boundaries between private life, work, and personal audiences.

entries.name: Personal Memory and Preference Corruption
entries.boundary: Integrity and currency of the agent's representation of the person.
entries.focus: Accuracy and correction of the agent's representation of its owner.

entries.name: Counterparty Deception and Agent Mediated Scams
entries.boundary: Verification of the external party or claim driving a personal transaction.
entries.focus: Consumer verification of counterparties and payment claims.

entries.name: Unauthorized Spending and Personal Commitments
entries.boundary: The exact economic or contractual effect accepted by the person.
entries.focus: Cumulative personal spending and consequential commitments.

entries.name: Unauthorized Social Representation
entries.boundary: Who may speak or make interpersonal representations in the person's name.
entries.focus: Authority over interpersonal speech and representation.

entries.name: Household and Bystander Consent Violations
entries.boundary: The autonomy and information interests of people other than the operator.
entries.focus: Nonuser interests, household roles, and legitimate-operator abuse.

entries.name: Manipulation of Personal Choice
entries.boundary: The person's ability to form and revise choices without covert influence.
entries.focus: Hidden incentives and pressure on personal choice.

entries.name: Loss of Personal Control and Continuity
entries.boundary: Ability to inspect, stop, exit, recover, and continue necessary activities.
entries.focus: Self-service stop, recovery, exit, and continuity.
